title: 36 Hours in Houston
abstract: This sprawling Texas city is inching back to its urban core: oil money still reigns supreme, but it now competes with culture.

title: 36 Hours in Kansas City, Mo.
abstract: A decade-long revitalization has transformed this former jazz mecca into a culturally rich metropolis.

title: 36 Hours in Santa Fe
abstract: Beyond the city’s historic center lie contemporary art spaces, hot Asian restaurants and a new park by a pair of trailblazing architects.

title: 36 Hours in Genoa, Italy
abstract: Genoa, no longer a way station on the Italian Riviera, is bustling with wine bars, restaurants and a newly refurbished waterfront.
